have. }} {{status |name = Life Regeneration |icon = Regeneration.png |type = |description = You are Regenerating Life |bonuses = base_life_regeneration_rate_per_minute }} '''Enduring Cry''' is a [[warcry]] [[skill]] that [[taunt]]s enemies in an area around the [[character]], and grants the user and allies a [[life regeneration]] [[buff]] and a number of [[endurance charge]]s, both based on the power of nearby enemies. Unlike most warcry skills, Enduring Cry does not [[exert]] your attacks. ==Skill functions and interactions== '''[[Power]]''': {{c|help|Normal Monsters have 1 Power, Magic Monsters 2, Rare Monsters 10, Unique Monsters 20, and Players 5}} '''[[Duration]]''': {{c|mod|Skill Effect Duration}}, {{c|mod|Buff Duration}}, and {{c|mod|Warcry Duration}} will only affect the duration of the regeneration buff, not the taunt or endurance charges. '''[[Warcry|Warcry Speed]]''': {{c|mod|Warcry Speed}} will accelerate the animation of enduring cry. {{c|mod|Cast Speed}} and {{c|mod|Attack Speed}} have no effect on warcry skills, as warcry skills are neither attacks nor spells. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Warcry
Speed |c1_header = x% increased Warcry Speed |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% increased Warcry Speed |c1_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Enduring Cry: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Enduring Cry%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} {{Skill threshold jewel list|stat_id=jewel_warcry}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( items.name LIKE "%warcry%" OR items.description LIKE "%warcry%" ) }} ==Related modifiers== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=granted_skill = "EnduringCry" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * No longer grants a brief burst of life regeneration, or a buff which grants resistances and physical damage reduction based on your endurance charges. * Instead, the user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants life regeneration. * The Buff grants 2% of Life Regenerated per second per 5 power, and can count a maximum of 25 power. * The base duration is now 2.5 seconds at gem level 1, scaling up to 3.4 at gem level 20 (previously 2 at all gem levels). * Additionally, nearby allied players are now granted Endurance Charges as well as the user. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. * Quality now provides 0-40% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate, instead of 0-20% increased Skill Effect Duration. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * No longer grants a minimum of one Endurance Charge. * Now has a cooldown of 8 seconds at all gem levels (from 6 seconds). * Monsters now use their own version of the new (as of [[Version 3.11.0|3.11.0]]) '''Enduring Cry'''. * Now has Alternate quality: ::{{c|gem|Anomalous}}: {{c|mod|2% increased Warcry Speed}} (per 1% quality) ::{{c|gem|Divergent }}: {{c|mod|2% reduced Cooldown Recovery Rate, 1% increased Buff Effect}} (per 1% quality) * (In a hotfix) Halved the life regeneration granted by [[Oak]]'s '''Enduring Cry''' and doubled its cooldown }} {{Version history table row|3.11.1| * Clarified the description of '''Enduring Cry''' to make it clear that the buff grants Elemental Resistances, rather than all Resistances. This is solely a description update. }} {{Version history table row|3.11.0| * The visual effects have been improved. * Now taunts all nearby enemies to attack the user, and grants endurance charges. Gives a brief burst of life regeneration, as well as a buff which grants resistances and physical damage reduction based on your endurance charges. * Now has a base duration of 2 seconds. * Now grants 1 endurance charge per 5 power, with a minium of 1 charge. * Buff grants +2% to all resistances and 2% additional Physical Damage reduction per endurance charge. * Now causes you to regenerate 120 life over 1 second at gem level 1, up to 1976 at gem level 20. * Labyrinth helmet enchantments that granted increased buff effect for Enduring Cry now grant increased cooldown reduction instead, and can no longer be obtained. This affects all existing items with this enchantment. * Use time has increased from 0.25s to 0.8s {{undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 7 (was 17). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 16 (was 21). }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * Added physics interactions. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.2| * Enduring Cry has received updated effects. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Enduring Cry is now a warcry rather than a spell. Shares a cooldown with other Warcry skills. * It now grants some life regeneration on use and grants 3% increased Area of Effect per 1% quality (was 1% per 1% quality). }} {{Version history table row|0.11.5| * The number of charges produced by Enduring Cry has been increased at all levels. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.5| * Cast time has been reduced from 0.7 seconds to 0.5 seconds. {{undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * The number of charges gained has been reduced at higher levels.
It produces the same amount at level 1, and progresses to being 40% less effective by level 20. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.11| * Now has a cooldown. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.6| * Substantially increased the range of the [[taunt]] effect for Enduring Cry. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.5| * Increased range of the Enduring Cry [[taunt]]. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.4| * Added new skill prototype: Enduring Cry ([[taunt]]s nearby [[monster]]s to [[attack]] you and grants [[Endurance Charge]]s based on how many are [[nearby]]). }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}}
